items.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: But I couldn’t get along with her husband, who was the same name as mine, his name was John Levy. And we couldn’t get along.

ctx.x: So anyway, we played the concert, did a double thing, two shows. And I stayed with Billie I guess maybe about, about a year. And we traveled. But I couldn’t get along with her husband, who was the same name as mine, his name was John Levy. And we couldn’t get along.
Yeah. And was he managing her kind of?
